title: Mandate Schema
description: A mandate is the permission slip the buyer agent must hold before any payment action is allowed. The validator rejects any proposed purchase that doesn't fit inside an active mandate.

mandate_id.description: Unique ID for this permission grant, e.g. 'MANDATE-0001'.

issued_to.description: Identifier of the buyer agent / session this mandate was granted to.

max_amount_inr.description: Total spending cap across ALL purchases under this mandate. Locked spec value: 3000.

used_amount_inr.description: Running total already spent under this mandate. The validator checks (used_amount_inr + proposed_price) <= max_amount_inr before approving.

scope.description: What the mandate allows spending on. Locked spec: restricted to catalog SKUs only, i.e. any SKU present and active in catalog.json. No off-catalog or delisted items, ever.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the mandate was created.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the mandate is invalid. Locked spec: issued_at + 24 hours.

status.description: active = usable. expired = past expires_at. exhausted = used_amount_inr has reached max_amount_inr. revoked = manually cancelled. Validator only approves purchases when status is 'active' AND expires_at is in the future.
